structural_breaks.note: IPO on the SSE STAR Market (sponsor 浙商证券; continuous supervision from 2021-03-09). FY2020 quarters are reconstructed from the prior-year columns of the FY2021 Q1/H1/Q3/annual reports (FY2020Q1 direct; Q2/Q3 ytd_difference; Q4 annual_minus_9m). No pre-2020 quarterly figures exist for the A-share entity.

Predecessor/affiliate Jinpan International Ltd (NASDAQ: JST, SEC CIK 1053008, US-GAAP, reported in CNY) went private — Form 15F-12B filed 2016-04-28. Its history is NOT merged into this series (different issuer/GAAP); see collection_notes for the SEC XBRL quarterly net sales 2012–2014.

profile.products: Per FY2025 AR p.15-17: 变压器系列 — cast-resin and VPI dry-type transformers (standard and special: wind step-up up to 72.5kV, PV, SFC for pumped storage up to 50,000kVA, rail, data centre), dry-type reactors, amorphous-alloy (dry & liquid) transformers, liquid-immersed power/distribution/offshore-wind transformers; 成套系列 — MV/LV switchgear, box/prefabricated substations, AIDC modular power; 储能系列 — PCS & storage systems; digital-factory solutions; industrial robots. Annual-only product revenue (AR 分产品 tables): 变压器系列 FY2023 4,092.58m, FY2024 4,027.55m; from FY2025 the AR groups 变压器系列+成套系列 as 电气设备系列 = 6,273.27m (FY2024 recast 5,992.89m), 储能系列 620.77m. Customers include Vestas, GE, Siemens Gamesa, Goldwind (wind transformers).

profile.end_markets: Wind (onshore/offshore turbines), PV, energy storage, data centres (AIDC), rail, industrial/infrastructure, grid. FY2025 export sales 2,298m = 31.78% of main-business revenue; export backlog 3,491m = 48.44% of 7,207m backlog (FY2025 AR p.39). 2026H1: new orders 7,493m (+69.31%), of which overseas 4,190m (55.92%), data-centre 3,869m (2026 H1 report p.12).
